name: Jobs Ready for Delivery
query:
select
	cwo.name as "Job:Link/Coach Work Order:150",
	cwo.customer_name as "Customer::180",
	v.registration_no as "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
	cwo.stage as "Stage:Link/Work Stage:140",
	cwo.expected_delivery_date as "Expected Delivery:Date:140",
	cwo.total_amount as "Amount:Currency:120",
	cwo.sales_invoice as "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150"
from `tabCoach Work Order` cwo
left join `tabVehicle` v on v.name = cwo.vehicle
where cwo.docstatus = 1 and cwo.status = 'Open'
	and cwo.stage = 'Ready'
order by cwo.expected_delivery_date asc
